input.summary: Kovai Finechem Pvt. Ltd. (contact R. Selvam, Sales) sent an offer (Kovai_Finechem_Offer.xlsx, own ERP format) and a sample COA for propanediol only. Open: RM-002 Glycerin quoted per litre with no density, so kg conversion is impossible; need density (g/mL at 20-25C). Outstanding knockouts: Q5 COA for each line (batch no., manufacturing date, retest date) and Q9 SDS plus confirmation of leave-on scalp suitability under Cosmetics Rules 2020. Vendor has not yet raised any questions or refusals. Response deadline 14 Nov 2026.

input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Information needed to complete your offer
input.body:
Dear R. Selvam,

Thank you for your offer and the sample COA for propanediol. To complete our evaluation, please send the following:

1. RM-002 Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade): your offer is quoted per litre, but we need kg pricing. Please confirm the density of the material (g/mL at 20-25 °C) so we can convert the quote to kg.

2. Certificate of Analysis (COA) for a recent batch of each of the 10 lines in this RFx, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. We have the propanediol COA; please send the other nine.

3. Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each material, and confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Please reply by 14 November 2026. Your offer can stay in your own format as long as the above is included.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
